arcgis_native_query.rule: Exact time-stamped lineage probing must use the official EPSG:27700 polygon feature layer and accept only returned attributes for the target point; no nearest-tile substitution.

wcs_numeric_route.rule: Numeric elevation promotion requires real WCS 2.0.1 raw-pixel or official raster bytes; WMS preview/display values are never numeric evidence.

hmlr_extent_scope.rule: INSPIRE polygons are indicative property extents and not legal title boundaries. They may be used as spatial masks for this analytical workflow but must not be described as definitive title extent.

hmlr_native_bng.rule: Keep exact point-in-polygon and elevation masking in British National Grid/EPSG:27700 where possible because HMLR warns reprojection can shift features.

numeric_claim.rule: No elevation, height difference, median, quartiles, min/max or parcel confidence is written until exact target lineage and real raster/archive bytes exist.

transport_fail_closed.rule: Tool safe-open policy, DNS resolution failure and unsupported XML transport are client/transport failures, not NO_DATA.
